prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need brand/creative, product/UX, or performance-driven growth. I can recommend agencies once I know more about what you need. Quick questions:

- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, ecommerce growth, SEO, paid media, UX/product design, etc.)
- Company stage and size? (startup, scale‑up, enterprise)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget (or a range)?
- Do you prefer a large full‑service agency or a smaller specialized team?
- Any industry focus (B2B tech, consumer, healthcare, finance, ecommerce)?

If you want immediate examples, here are some well‑regarded agencies with San Francisco presence and their typical strengths:
- R/GA — large, creative & technology‑driven campaigns and brand experience.
- AKQA — product design and digital experiences for big brands.
- Huge — user experience, digital product design and integrated campaigns.
- Metric Theory — performance marketing, paid search and social (growth/ROI focused).

If you tell me your answers to the questions above, I’ll shortlist 3–5 SF agencies that match your needs and include estimated costs, pros/cons, and suggested questions to ask them.
